description: Coastal Resilience Index is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Gulf of America Alliance | Coastal Community Resilience Team; Louisiana Sea Grant; Mississippi-Alabama Sea Grant Consortium. Coastal communities can complete this questionnaire to assess their level of preparedness for extreme events. The self-assessment exercise helps them discuss and discover their climate-related vulnerabilities. To determine their score, community leaders lead a discussion about their community’s resilience to coastal hazards. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Cultural and Community Services, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
